description: Image Description: The image features a cluster of traffic signs mounted on a single metal pole against a cloudy, overcast sky. At the top is a rectangular street sign with the text "KIRKBRIDGE DR" in black capital letters on a white background. Below it is a standard red octagonal stop sign with the word "STOP" in large white capital letters. Written diagonally across the lower portion of the stop sign in white graffiti-style lettering is the phrase "HAMMER TIME."
